finding_conventions.allocation: affected_ids=[payment_id] plus every invoice_id whose ledger allocation differs from the payment's invoice_refs; amount=total base-currency shortfall; evidence must include the payment doc_id, the doc_id of EVERY invoice listed in affected_ids, and the changed or added ledger row(s) of that payment (e.g. the unapplied line).
finding_conventions.cutoff: affected_ids=all ledger row_ids of the document's journal whose reporting period differs from the document's period; amount=larger of the debit/credit totals of those rows; evidence must include the doc_id and one such row.
finding_conventions.duplicate: affected_ids=[invoice_id|payment_id of a document whose journal is posted more than once]; amount=base-currency amount of the extra posting(s) (anchor line); evidence must include the document doc_id and the anchor line of the original and of the repost.
finding_conventions.fx: affected_ids=[invoice_id|payment_id]; amount=|booked - correct| of the anchor line in base currency; evidence must include the doc_id, one ledger row of the journal and the fx record id (FX-date-SRC-TGT) that policy prescribes.

fx.rate_date_rule: calendar date of the document timestamp converted to the company timezone; daily rates incl. weekends
fx.semantics: 1 unit of source_currency = rate units of base currency

ledger_amounts: debit_minor/credit_minor are base-currency minor units; the currency column is the currency of the source document.

postings.payment: Dr 1000 cash = sum of lines | Cr 1200 per invoice_ref | Cr 2300 for amount not allocated

recognition_rule: A journal belongs to the reporting period that contains its document timestamp (invoice.issued_at / payment.timestamp) compared as an instant; the booking timestamp must fall in the same period.
